items.summary: Handoff: retain the CRO CTA, content-ingestion, and execution-control concepts as deferred backlog only. Their evidence supports future bounded prototypes, but current failure ownership, validation, rollback, measurement, and release evidence do not support queue entry. No adoption, dependency addition, deployment, or requeue is authorized.

Approve containment-only execution. Retain SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content, affiliate, CTA, content-ingestion, and execution-control opportunities as deferred backlog only. Do not create or requeue implementation work, add dependencies or telemetry, deploy, spend, expand monetization, launch publicly, or conduct external outreach. Continue existing repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement/attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work.

Technical feasibility is not the blocker for deferred opportunities; safe queue entry is blocked by 47 open failure follow-ups, 28 improvements awaiting measurement, incomplete operations and security evidence, and an empty candidate list. Reconsider only after ownership, root cause, isolation, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, release readiness, and measurement boundaries are documented using existing recorded telemetry.
